observations: A stack of two Sony PlayStation 4 consoles is shown; both feature the three-tier chassis design unique to the Pro model.
Two boxed DualShock 4 wireless controllers in red are resting on top of the consoles.
The consoles have strips of yellow tape applied to their sides, common in imported bulk electronics.
A watermark 'GAME ARENAOFFICAL' is overlaid on the image.
The background includes a wall with UK-style (Type G) power outlets and plugs.
The 'SONY' and 'PS4' logos are visible on the top console unit.

claims.claim: Very clean UK-Used PS4 Pro Console
claims.evidence: The exterior appears intact, but 'clean' is subjective and 'UK-used' cannot be confirmed from a photo alone.
No physical game discs or digital library screens are visible in the photo.
Two boxed controllers are shown in photo 0.
The photo shows the units but does not provide enough detail to confirm the level of wear.
The rear of the console, where the factory warranty seals are located, is not shown.
The boxed controllers may be high-quality clones; the labels on the back of the controllers are not visible.
The receipt mentioned is not pictured.

risks.risk: The console may have been opened for repair or cleaning.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the factory warranty seals on the rear of the console.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a previously opened/repaired unit

risks.risk: The console might be non-functional (e.g., Blue Light of Death or faulty disc drive).
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen and successfully loading a game disc.

risks.risk: The controllers may be third-party clones rather than genuine Sony originals.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the model sticker on the back of the controllers.

risks.risk: The 10 games may be missing or tied to a non-transferable digital account.
risks.proof: A photo of the physical game discs or the console's storage menu showing the installed games.

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the console showing the warranty seals and model number sticker.
Video of the console powered on and running a game disc.
Photos of the 10 games (discs or digital library).
Photo of the UK receipt mentioned in the description.
Close-up photo of the back of the controllers.
response.reason: The item is clearly a PS4 Pro based on the three-tier design and branding in photo 0. Although the photo shows two units and the text describes one, it can be priced as a single PS4 Pro unit at the worst case for unverified functionality.
